svg.title: Brumaire 15 — Dindon
svg.desc: A quiet male domestic turkey stands in three-quarter profile facing left. A small bare grey-blue head bears a short pale bill, a pendent muted red snood and a folded red throat wattle. Its broad umber body carries scalloped bronze-brown plumage, a folded barred wing and a dark breast beard. A partly opened tail rises from the rump in long brown feathers with dark bands and pale buff tips. Two stout scaled legs end in separate clawed bird toes.
